conventions: Variable-count positive-rate convention. Solvers at different rates in the negation may be different algorithms.
definition: There is a positive exponential rate below which deterministic variable-3SAT cannot be solved.
model: Deterministic decision on explicit 3-CNF formulas. Let n be the number of variables and L the complete input length.
name: Exponential Time Hypothesis
quantifiers: There exists δ > 0 such that, for every fixed C ≥ 0, no correct algorithm runs in O(2^(δ n) L^C).

source.locator: Definition of s_k and Theorem 1, item 3, p. 368
